_comment: swe's promise is stated in the SAME per-token form as chat and deepresearch: TTFT 7 s + 75 ms per token (FluidServe v0.4 section 1.3). This file is for the policies that read slo.<class>.tbt_ms LITERALLY as the per-token target -- PolyServe, llm-d and Llumnix SLO -- because none of them can express an end-to-end budget. It replaces the *_slofair files for those policies under the per-token form: there is nothing left to restate, 75 IS the promise. FluidServe uses the sibling *_t75 file instead, where swe keeps tbt_ms 25 as a TIER KEY and the real budget arrives as --fluidserve-class-budgets 25:decode:75. Scoring for BOTH is FS_SWE_TBT_MS=75, so the policy and the scorer judge the same quantity.
